q: Why was Antonia walking to Russian Peter's house?
span: TO BORROW A SPADE AMBROSCH NEEDED
fact: Antonia was going to borrow a spade that Ambrosch needed.

q: Why did he travel to a distant city on a particular day every year?
span: TO COLLECT MONEY ON AN ACCOUNT
fact: The annual trip was to collect money on an account.

q: What meeting was he going to try to persuade Catherine to allow?
span: PERSUADING CATHERINE TO GRANT SYDNEY AN INTERVIEW
fact: He would try to persuade Catherine to give Sydney an interview.

q: Which flowers should the woman have been holding up to his face?
span: HER HANDS SHOULD HAVE BEEN FULL OF BLUEBELLS
fact: The imagined flowers in her hands were bluebells.

q: What conflicting feelings did Colonel Leonidas Talbot have about the white flag?
span: TRIUMPH AND SADNESS WERE MINGLED STRANGELY
fact: Talbot felt both triumph and sadness.

q: What precaution did the guide require before the signal to pull him up?
span: FASTEN HIM SECURELY TO THE LOOP BEFORE YOU GIVE THE SIGNAL TO HAUL UP
fact: He had to be securely fastened to the loop before the hauling signal.

q: Whose palace did the guide say the little stone building was?
span: THE PALACE OF TOURMALINE WHO IS OUR QUEEN
fact: The little stone building was the palace of Queen Tourmaline.

q: Who was Deucalion's father in the ancient story?
span: HE WAS THE SON OF PROMETHEUS
fact: Deucalion was the son of Prometheus.

q: What is the yellow grain sold by grocers for making puddings called?
span: A YELLOW VARIETY CALLED GOLDEN MILLET
fact: The yellow pudding grain was called golden millet.

q: What sound did the thousands of birds answer with their songs?
span: THOUSANDS OF BIRDS ANSWERED THE MUSIC OF FOUNTAINS WITH THEIR SONGS
fact: The birds answered the music of fountains.

q: For what alleged offense had the former bank clerk been transported?
span: WAS TRANSPORTED FOR EMBEZZLEMENT
fact: The former clerk was transported for embezzlement, although some doubted his guilt.

q: Where was the first act's cabin scene supposed to take place?
span: THE INTERIOR OF A CABIN IN THE SOUTH OF IRELAND
fact: The first act was set inside a cabin in southern Ireland.

q: How many months did the discovered Martian calendar divide the year into?
span: THE YEAR HAD BEEN DIVIDED INTO TEN MORE OR LESS EQUAL MONTHS
fact: The Martian year had ten approximately equal months.

q: Who was going to make all the arrangements for the narrator's wedding?
span: ALL THE ARRANGEMENTS FOR MY WEDDING ARE GOING TO BE MADE BY THE SNELLINGS
fact: The Snellings were going to arrange the wedding.

q: What was the practical joke played on the physicians?
span: SENT HALF DRESSED TO SOME NOBLEMAN WHO WAS ENJOYING EXCELLENT HEALTH
fact: The physicians were sent half dressed to a nobleman who was actually healthy.

q: Why could the traveler choose to leave the blanket behind?
span: WOOD FOR FIRES IS EVERYWHERE ABUNDANT
fact: Abundant firewood made it possible to do without the blanket.

q: Where was the Gwynplaine the Laughing Man placard hung after removal from the green box?
span: WAS HUNG UP CLOSE TO THE SIGN OF THE INN
fact: The placard was hung beside the inn's sign.

q: What was painted on the house signboards that made the traveler feel at home?
span: WAS PAINTED A BOTTLE AND A GLASS
fact: The signboards depicted a bottle and a glass.

q: Where had Lady Milborough wanted him to take his wife?
span: TAKEN HER OFF WITH HIM TO NAPLES
fact: Lady Milborough wanted him to return to his wife and take her to Naples.

q: Where did Thompson open the restaurant praised for its cooking and service?
span: IN O'FARRELL STREET JUST ABOVE FILLMORE
fact: Thompson's restaurant was on O'Farrell Street just above Fillmore.
